outline:
本課主要講授商事法的規定。相關的法律理論儘量會被介紹。學生將被指定閱讀教科書和法院判決。課堂參與是必要的。
This course teaches Commercial Act. Commercial Act covers Corporate Act, Insurance Contract Law, Maritime Law, and Law of Negotiable Instrumernts.Students are required to read a textbook and several court decisions. Class participation is mandatory.
